label: Demonstration data — not actual market performance.
disclaimer: Generated locally by Outfox from a fixed seed. Not fetched, copied, or derived from any market-data provider. Does not represent the price, return, or performance of any real fund, and must never be presented as historical market data or as an investment result.
method: Geometric random walk. Per-step log change is a fixed drift plus a standard normal shock scaled by a fixed volatility, both invented for the demonstration rather than measured from any market. Randomness is mulberry32 seeded by an FNV-1a hash of the symbol, so output is identical on every run and every machine.

gaps.reason: Deliberate gap in the demonstration fixture, to exercise date alignment.
